svg.aria-label: The change was merged at 08:12 and deployed at 08:31. Errors passed 5% at 08:40, and saving failed for 47 minutes, until 09:27. The page came at 08:44; the cause was found at 09:14, after 8 minutes spent on read replicas, and the rollback started at 09:19.

The change was merged at 08:12 and deployed at 08:31. Errors passed 5% at 08:40, and saving failed for 47 minutes, until 09:27. The page came at 08:44; the cause was found at 09:14, after 8 minutes spent on read replicas, and the rollback started at 09:19.

tr.td: Platform engineer. A change to the shared configuration template moves the pool size into a new section, where a default of 20 applies.
The deploy pipeline sends the new configuration to all three regions at once.
People could not save changes. Up to 61% of requests failed.
Monitoring. The alert "sync errors above 5% for 3 minutes" pages the on-call engineer.
The status page says saving is failing.
On the guess that the database is overloaded. Errors do not change.
Database engineer. "Connection pool exhausted, limit 20" in the API logs, and the change in the deploy history.
The app sends its kept changes again.
Support lead, after an hour with no errors.

ul.li: 14 rows: 13 events and 1 span, from 08:12 to 10:30 UTC (2 h 18 min).
Longest gap: 1 h 3 min, from 09:27 to 10:30.
